spec_variables.DEPENDENCY_POLICY: Python standard library only; do not install packages

agent_notes: The entry module is `picc.py` in the workspace root; the fixed build command runs `mypy --strict` on it (following its imports) and fails on any type error, so a snapshot that does not type-check has no product. Write explicit type annotations for function signatures and data structures, prefer precise types over `Any`, and never suppress the checker with `# type: ignore` or `# mypy: ignore-errors`.
